description: Defines the android::Rect class, a rectangle utility with various constructors, methods, and operators for rectangle manipulation, including conversion to float rect, comparison, and transformation functions.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with integer coordinates, providing methods for creation, validation, comparison, transformation, and conversion to float rectangle.

methods.name: makeInvalid
methods.description: Marks the rectangle as invalid.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the rectangle to zero coordinates.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle has non-negative width and height.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle is empty (zero or negative dimensions).

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the rectangle.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the rectangle.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (width and height) of the rectangle.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns a rectangle representing the bounds.

methods.name: setLeftTop
methods.description: Sets the top-left point of the rectangle.

methods.name: setRightBottom
methods.description: Sets the bottom-right point of the rectangle.

methods.name: leftTop
methods.description: Returns the top-left corner as a Point.

methods.name: rightBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom-right corner as a Point.

methods.name: rightTop
methods.description: Returns the top-right corner as a Point.

methods.name: leftBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom-left corner as a Point.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Equality comparison between rectangles.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between rectangles.

methods.name: operator <
methods.description: Defines an order for rectangles.

methods.name: operator +
methods.description: Returns a new rectangle offset by a Point.

methods.name: operator -
methods.description: Returns a new rectangle offset by a Point.

methods.name: operator +=
methods.description: Offsets the rectangle by a Point.

methods.name: operator -=
methods.description: Offsets the rectangle by a Point.

methods.name: offsetToOrigin
methods.description: Offsets rectangle to origin (0,0).

methods.name: offsetTo
methods.description: Offsets rectangle to a specific Point.

methods.name: offsetBy
methods.description: Offsets rectangle by delta x and y.

methods.name: offsetTo
methods.description: Offsets rectangle to specific x and y coordinates.

methods.name: offsetBy
methods.description: Offsets rectangle by specific x and y deltas.

methods.name: inset
methods.description: Insets the rectangle on all sides.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Calculates intersection with another rectangle.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms rectangle using a graphics HAL transform.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales the rectangle by given factors.

methods.name: scaleSelf
methods.description: Scales the rectangle in place.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Calculates the difference between this rectangle and another.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the rectangle.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the rectangle.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets rectangle to another rectangle.

methods.name: toFloatRect
methods.description: Converts rectangle to a FloatRect.
